Stage 7a: a brain gene in the pack world
Stage 7c: food that poisons, brains with memory

moments.caption: Hunter #36 (gold arrow) has settled on one cell in a thicket. Nobody told it to. It makes four catches in this episode, at steps 23, 54, 66 and 119, each by stepping one cell and going straight back. Before the last one it waits 52 steps.

Grazer #354 (gold arrow) is born knowing nothing about today's food. Nothing shows which plant is safe. Watch "change this step" at step 169: its first bite is poison. Its next 11 bites are all the kind that feeds. One animal, not the proof: the test measures whole populations.
